name: optimuskg
description: MCP server bundle exposing the OptimusKG biomedical knowledge graph for natural-language querying.
long_description: OptimusKG is a multimodal biomedical knowledge graph integrating dozens of resources across genes, diseases, drugs, pathways, phenotypes, anatomy, exposures, and ontology terms. This bundle exposes the graph over the Model Context Protocol. On first use it fetches the published graph from Harvard Dataverse via the `optimuskg` Python client and builds a local, indexed DuckDB database; thereafter every query runs locally. It provides curated tools for entity search, neighbourhood exploration, connection finding, and aggregation, plus a guarded read-only SQL escape hatch for arbitrary questions.

tools.name: list_schema
tools.description: Node types, edge types, and the relation vocabulary of the graph.

tools.name: search_entities
tools.description: Resolve a name, gene symbol, synonym, or id to graph entities.

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: Full properties of an entity plus a summary of its connections.

tools.name: get_neighbors
tools.description: One-hop neighbours, filterable by relation, edge type, direction, and score.

tools.name: count_neighbors
tools.description: Aggregate an entity's neighbours by edge type, relation, or neighbour type.

tools.name: find_connection
tools.description: Shortest path(s) between two entities (default 2 hops).

tools.name: run_sql
tools.description: Read-only SQL escape hatch over the nodes and edges tables.
